Tune all five cluster amplifiers on one cluster and balance the books. Each running amplifier costs fluid by its tier — 4/8/12/16 L/s — and applies its multiplier to the steam bill: parallel ×1.3, speed ×1.4, primary output ×2.0, secondary output ×1.6, steam saver ×1.1.

Primary output boosts take only the highest of their kind; secondary boosts add up; steam savings cap at 48% total.

The question every cluster engineer answers differently: how much parallel can you afford?
